title: Retire the dead review kind in loopctl-runner and re-vendor contract 1.24.0

story.i_want_to: the runner to declare only the kinds loopctl can dispatch
story.so_that: the spec registry starts from the two real kinds and the runner's contract matches loopctl's

rationale: loopctl retired review as a dispatch kind in contract 1.23.0 (runner_contract.ex:579-580, migration 20261018120000), but loopctl-runner still declares @kinds [implement, review, triage] (control.ex:401), keeps review_dispatch/review_run/review_prompt/review_judgements and priv/bin/loop-review-*/loop-finding, and vendors contract 1.22.0. Dead code that a spec registry would otherwise have to model.

acceptance_criteria.description: LoopctlRunner.Control declares kinds ["implement", "triage"] on join; the review kind's modules, prompts and priv/bin helpers are deleted, and so is thread-mode checkpoint reporting that served only contract 1.20/1.21.
priv/runner_contract/v1.json and contract.ex vendor loopctl's contract 1.24.0; the runner's contract test passes against it.
No dispatch outcome changes: an implement or triage dispatch is accepted and run exactly as before, and a review dispatch is refused kind_not_supported as any unknown kind is.
README.md describes two kinds and drops every review-kind section.

test_cases.name: join declares two kinds
steps: start Control against a fake socket

test_cases.name: review dispatch refused
steps: send a dispatch with kind review

test_cases.name: implement and triage unchanged
steps: run the existing implement and triage dispatch tests

technical_notes: Repo: loopctl-runner. Independent of the loopctl stories; can run beside US-48.2.
Check loopctl's runner_pool after deploy: every runner's kinds list loses review and suppressed_kinds does not grow.
